text:
Situation: Hydrocodone bitartrate and acetaminophen 10 mg tablets are below 30 days on hand at all three Corvale sites. Corvale Lakeside holds 59 units at 4.8 units per day for 12 days. Corvale East holds 263 units at 15.7 units per day for 17 days. Corvale General holds 558 units at 19.4 units per day for 29 days.

Why (FDA record): The product label identifies Proficient Rx LP as the repackager with FEI 3011557028. FDA inspection records for that FEI show a VAI classification on 2015-10-22 and a VAI classification on 2022-12-08. The drug is not listed on the FDA drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory will not sustain operations beyond 29 days at the best-supplied site. No FDA shortage listing exists to trigger allocation programs. Alternative suppliers are available but their manufacturing sites are not identified on their labels.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place immediate orders with A-S Medication Solutions, Alvogen Inc., American Health Packaging, Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC, and Amneal Pharmaceuticals of New York LLC to cover projected 60-day usage across all sites; buyer approves purchase orders.
2. Buyer to request manufacturing site information from each alternative supplier before first shipment; buyer and quality assurance approve supplier qualification.
3. Pharmacy director to approve inter-site transfer of 100 units from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside this week; pharmacy director approves transfer.
4. Buyer to report weekly inventory and days on hand to P&T committee until all sites exceed 45 days; buyer approves report.

Not recommended: Delaying purchases until a site reaches zero stock. Relying solely on current repackager without qualified alternates.
